description.subtitle: Sports need Rinat (29 x 18 x 17) cm - black
description.intro: The Rinat Etnik is lightweight and durable, ideal for organizing your personal or toilet items. Its functional design makes it an indispensable accessory for training and travel.
key_benefits: Order by hand: Store accessories and personal items with ease.
Ligero y compacto: Perfecto para llevar en mochila o maleta.
Acceso seguro: Cierre con cremallera para proteger el contenido.
Versatile: Works for both toilet and small objects.
